semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Aegiq focuses on photonic quantum computing, which leverages semiconductor technologies but is not primarily a semiconductor supplier.
summary: Aegiq is developing scalable, fault-tolerant photonic quantum systems designed for integration with conventional data center infrastructure. Their technology aims to simplify quantum computing deployments by significantly reducing the number of required components, thus enhancing efficiency and reliability in high-value applications.
capabilities: Integration with HPC and data centers

regional_presence.United Kingdom: Aegiq has deployed its first-generation quantum computer at the NQCC in the UK.
